title: Companions can be dropped to critically low HP (1/9) or knocked down ('crawls clear of the fight') by 'armor useless' undead in scripted corridor fights with no in-fiction way to heal them short of a distant hearth; only self-targeted heal items exist, so a long dungeon push (Coldpass→Marrowgate→crypts) has no mid-dungeon safety valve.
where: The Ring-Ditch / The Old Crypts barrow-wight and honour-guard fights
